trigger: False comparison failure or silent drift when comparing ISO timestamps with explicit timezone offsets
root_cause: Using .replace(tzinfo=None) strips the timezone offset without converting to UTC, causing false mismatches between local and UTC representations.
verified_remedy: Normalize timezone-aware timestamps using .astimezone(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None) before comparison.
limitations: Requires valid ISO-8601 strings or datetime objects; invalid strings raise ValueError.
